name: 28-day AI-cost vs output report for two teams, with per-user detail
description: An engineering manager asks for a Copilot ROI report for the platform-eng and payments teams. Ticking per-user detail triggers the Copilot-admin escalation. The execution job joins the users-1-day, user-teams-1-day NDJSON reports with merged pull requests, reviews and AI-credit cost, then renders the go-echarts HTML report, CSV exports and Prometheus metrics for Grafana.

issue.title: [IssueOps] Copilot usage report: platform-eng + payments, last 28 days

selected: Include a per-user breakdown (requires Copilot admin approval)

values.report_purpose: Quarterly business review: compare AI-credit spend against merged pull requests and review throughput for platform-eng and payments, and identify seats that are not being used before the October true-up.

steps.note: Another manager is not an eligible approver for the per-user escalation.

steps.body: .approve Per-user detail OK for the QBR; do not forward the CSV outside the leadership group.
